description: Right now, Central Kentuckians are facing skyrocketing costs while politicians in Washington do the bidding of insurance companies instead of constituents and patients. One in three Kentuckians rely on Medicaid for their health coverage. Cutting Medicaid hurts families, threatens our hospitals, and eliminates good-paying jobs. We need to reverse these cuts and fully fund Medicaid […]
